description: The plot illustrates the relationship between co-occurrence number and accuracy (ACC) for several models. The x-axis is labeled “Co-occurrence Number” and has a logarithmic scale, ranging from 1 to 1000, with tick labels at 1, 10, 100, and 1000. The y-axis is labeled “ACC (%)” and has a linear scale, ranging from 60 to 85, with tick labels at intervals of 5.  The black line, representing “Base”, is a solid line with circular markers, starting at approximately 64% at a co-occurrence number of 1 and increasing to approximately 71% at a co-occurrence number of 1000. The blue line, representing “FT”, is a solid line with triangular markers, beginning at approximately 67% at a co-occurrence number of 1 and rising to approximately 72% at a co-occurrence number of 1000. The red line, representing “IKE”, is a solid line with triangular markers, starting at approximately 69% at a co-occurrence number of 1 and increasing to approximately 74% at a co-occurrence number of 1000. The brown line, representing “MEND”, is a solid line with diamond markers, beginning at approximately 71% at a co-occurrence number of 1 and rising to approximately 78% at a co-occurrence number of 1000. The purple line, representing “ROME”, is a solid line with square markers, starting at approximately 74% at a co-occurrence number of 1 and increasing to approximately 83% at a co-occurrence number of 1000. The green line, representing “ROME”, is a solid line with square markers, beginning at approximately 74% at a co-occurrence number of 1 and rising to approximately 83% at a co-occurrence number of 1000.
